name: What is the typical process for planning an accessible home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for planning an accessible home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an in-home assessment to evaluate entryways, room layouts, and daily routines. Next, your contractor creates a design plan tailored to your functional needs, whether that involves floor plan reconfiguration, cabinetry updates, or plumbing relocations. Once plans and permits are finalized, construction proceeds through demolition, rough-in plumbing and electrical, structural framing (such as adding wall backing for grab bars), finish installations, and final walkthroughs. Blue Lake Construction coordinates all trades under a dedicated project manager to keep the remodeling timeline organized and transparent.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with an in-home assessment, followed by layout design, permitting, rough framing and plumbing updates, finish installations, and a final walkthrough.
